_meta.description: Typhon's Forge model library — provenance and attribution index

categories.external: Downloaded from Cults3D, Thingiverse, MakerWorld, Printables etc. — license must be verified before commercial use
categories.terp-tribe: Terp Tribe community designs — use governed by Terp Tribe agreement
categories.forge: Typhon's Forge originals — owned by Javier, commercial use unrestricted

license_statuses.verified-commercial: License confirmed — commercial use permitted (with any required attribution)
license_statuses.verified-personal-only: License confirmed — personal/non-commercial use only. DO NOT LIST IN SHOP.
license_statuses.tf-transformed-pending-counsel: TF modifications are substantial (bore + engrave + mark) — transformation argument may apply, but license is restrictive. Do not list until resolved.
license_statuses.pending-review: License not yet confirmed — treat as personal-only until verified

modification_levels.significant: Bore added, proportions changed, or surface features added
modification_levels.substantial-transformation: Bore + engravings + embossing + maker's mark + rescale — resulting mesh shares base silhouette only; topology, surface geometry, and function substantially changed
